title: Nominations open for The MIDORI Prize for Biodiversity 2026 by AEON Environmental Foundation and the Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity
summary: The MIDORI Prize recognizes outstanding individual contributions to the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity The unique prize contributes to raising public awareness of the essential role biodiversity plays for human well-being and in addressing global challenges such as climate change The Award Ceremony and Award Winners Forum will be held on 27 August 2026 […]
